reasoning: Plan A is the better choice for an athlete aiming to become a faster trail runner. While both plans incorporate rest days, Plan A includes a tempo run and a longer run, which are crucial for developing speed and endurance – key components of faster trail running. Plan B consists almost entirely of easy runs, which are good for building a base but insufficient for significant speed gains. The structured intensity variation in Plan A is more likely to lead to performance improvements.
